newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Transwater unit to develop school land.
newsitem.headline: Transwater unit to develop school land.

text.p: Malaysia's Transwater Corp Bhd said its 60 percent subsidiary has been awarded a privatisation contract from the government to develop a piece of school land into a commercial centre.
Sejati Avenue Sdn Bhd will develop the 14.4-acre land in the capital city into a complex comprising a hotel, a convention hall and a shopping centre.
Sejati will in turn build a new school as replacement and also other schools and facilities at another location in the capital on a 38-acre site, the statement said.
The new schools, built on the concept of "smart school", will have information technology facilities linking them to other schools, Sejati said in an accompanying statement.
Transwater is mainly involved in engineering services and has a privatisation contract to run Malaysia's sewerage treatment systems.
